# VV Work

> VV Work is a platform for finding jobs, employees, and verified employers across Europe.

VV Work helps candidates find job opportunities across Europe and helps employers connect with potential employees.

## Main pages

- [English homepage](https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en)
- [Ukrainian homepage](https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/uk)
- [Contacts](https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en/contacts)

- [Logistics Group](https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en/partners/logistics-group)

## Main content

VV Work provides information about:

- Job vacancies across Europe
- Job opportunities by country and category
- Verified employers and partners
- Employer profiles and available vacancies
- Recruitment opportunities for employers
- Job opportunities for candidates
